page.layout: One printed page of running text in one column. Running head at top, page number at top left. No marginal notes. Catchword at bottom right.

main_text.p: Circa aures habent Auriculas extrinsecus adna-tas, in formam conchae effiguratas, quo soni tanto rectius percipiantur.
Oculorum palpebrae Ciliis etiam sunt munitae: pi-lis scilicet ex inferiore palpebrarum extremitate enatis, ad visum rectius dirigendum.
Os deniq; habent duplici maxilla constans.
In trunco, communia quaedam habent utrq; se-xus, quaedam propria: sive interius contenta, sive exterius adnata.
Interius communiter continent, viscera peculiaria in inferiore cavitate trunci, nempe Lienem & Renes: atq; membranas quasdam in cavitate utravis.
Lien est viscus, carne spongiosa, in sinistro la-tere ex adverso epatis situm, ad humorem melancholicum superfluum, ut eo etiam alatur, ex-cipiendum.

Renes sunt viscera, carne solida & compacta, ex utroq; latere, sub epate & liene unum, sita, ad serosum & aquosum humorem, secundae concoctionis excrementum, per venas emulgentes recipiendum, ac postea per vasa alia venosa (u-reteres dicta) in vesicam demittendum.

p.i: Membranae peculiares in superiore cavitate trunci sunt, Mediastinus & Capsula cordis.

main_text.p: Mediastinus est membrana gemina, dorso sub collo usq; ad diaphragma annata, totum pectus secundum longitudinem in dextrum & sinistrū latus dividens.

page.notes: Long s read as s throughout; the "f"-like forms in the scan (sive, sexus, secundae, spongiosa, situm, superfluum, sub, serosum, sinistrum) are long s. The running head is rendered with u/v normalised. Italic and roman boundaries in the Latin are approximate where the scan is faint. The hyphenated line-break forms (adna-tas, pi-lis, la-tere, ex-cipiendum, u-reteres) keep the printed hyphen. The line "dextrum & sinistrū" is partly faint and may need checking. The first paragraph is treated as a new paragraph, as it is indented, not a continuation.
